caption: The drawing depicts a single stoneware jar centered on a plain, off-white background. The jar has a cylindrical, slightly tapered body with two small handles on opposite sides near the top. Its surface is colored in various shades of brown, giving a natural, glazed pottery appearance with dark and light tonal variations. The jar's rim appears darker on the inside, and the top opening reveals an unadorned, reddish-brown interior. Decorative blue markings are on the front: a stylized floral motif with a branch-like line beneath it, a raised number "2" near the motif, and the year "1846" written below in blue. The drawing is signed "P. Ward" in the lower right corner of the page. The background paper shows minor speckling and age marks but is otherwise unadorned.
title: Pottery Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
